Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly changed the chosen mechanism from reflection to refraction, asserting that sunglasses protect “primarily because the lenses refract incoming rays away,” and concluded option D. The cited sources describe reducing light/glare via blocking/absorption, polarization, mirror coatings (reflection), and wraparound frames—not refraction of rays away. This misinterpretation led to selecting D instead of the correct A (reflecting light rays away from the eyes).
